rules: Use synthetic accounts and isolated DSH Home, working directory, ports and database.
Never reuse daily tokens, tasks or database.
Read both TiDB memory limits before testing.
A real-model label requires actual remote model requests; deterministic fixtures are protocol tests.
Store per-run commit IDs, environment, logs and pass/fail/skip/not-run separately.
Verify effects through canonical APIs; model prose is not proof.
Keep failed attempts and distinguish fixture errors from product failures.

suites.loopWebRegression: web/e2e/projectTaskAssignee.spec.ts — create a second workspace by name, follow the empty member search to its directory, create an agent on a connected host and grant the selected member after returning.
suites.preconditions: Two independent DSH sessions with the same assistant and two participating Loop Agents in a private channel, a second Human and their guest Agent, plus a nonmember. Supply a dedicated DeepSeek test credential.

checks.fresh-workspaces: Create a second Loop workspace for the same owner and a second DSH working folder after sign-in. Verify the old workspace musician is absent, then dispatch to the new workspace musician with the same name and read back its delivery.
checks.topic-mentions: Both topics target both selected Agent IDs in Loop delivery diagnostics.
checks.cross-owner: A second Human accepts a workspace invite, enrolls their own guest Agent and contributes in the topic. Loop rejects enrollment by the other owner. Verify the guest receives the mention and the author uses the peer feedback.
checks.cross-review: The editor quotes the author’s draft reference and the author quotes the editor’s review in the revision. Check all authors against persisted member IDs.
checks.retry-once: An identical retry of the revised draft leaves exactly one message.
checks.private-topic: A nonmember cannot read the private topic.
checks.parent-isolation: Topic-only replies do not appear on the parent timeline.
checks.session-push: The revised draft arrives as a pushed event in the original DSH session.
checks.coordinator-summary: The coordinator summarizes the received final reference in its own session.
checks.overlapping-topics: Separate both topics and original sessions even when both rooms have the same participants.
checks.removed-member: Removing a participant from the channel revokes its read access to the existing topic.

suites.setup: Use a new DSH folder linked to a private test channel. Use two or more available Loop agents and a private project the assistant and worker have not joined. Substitute only their display names. Start from a new conversation for each prompt.

cases.prompt: 让 {agent} 帮我写首下班路上哼的小曲。
cases.verify: An actual task on the intended board, the named assignee's delivery, and its return in the originating conversation.

cases.prompt: 帮我找 {agent}，在「{project}」这个项目里写首春天的小诗。写好了让我看看。
cases.followUp: 也把 {agent} 加到这个项目里当普通成员吧，下回还要找它。
cases.followUpCheck: Read the membership table before and after the follow-up. Verify the requested worker and ordinary role. Count each new or reused authorization prompt and any turn the user must restart.
cases.verify: Record every user interruption verbatim. Check the project, assignee, membership and final poem against Loop. Count who actually contributed and whether the user had to copy a link or ID.

cases.prompt: 让 {author} 和 {reviewer} 一起给周一早上的闹钟想句台词吧，一个先出主意，另一个挑挑毛病，商量好给我一句。
cases.verify: Both named workers contribute in the same discussion. Match the draft, critique, author confirmation and the line sent back to the original DSH conversation.

cases.prompt: 帮我查一下「{project}」的项目编号。
cases.setup: Revoke the dedicated test lookup grant first. Keep the assistant outside the project and use a fresh DSH conversation.
cases.verify: The named lookup matches the project visible to the owner. Record any request for a broader directory, whether the name is legible and what the assistant does if the user declines.

cases.prompt: 在「{channel}」频道里帮我找那条带“闹钟”的消息，我想看原话。
cases.setup: Post a known message in a dedicated private test channel and verify the text in Loop first.
cases.verify: Match the original text and author. Record whether the user has an actionable confirmation if access is missing, and whether they are asked to find or paste the message themselves.
variants: Use a unique shortened display name with a suffix on the actual channel.
Reuse the prefix across two channels and verify neither history is read without clarification.

cases.prompt: 把我名下的全部 Loop 资源按类型列出来，带上名称和 ID。
cases.verify: Place a project outside assistant membership. Verify the owner directory includes it, handles pagination, and any whole-directory consent follows this explicit request.

cases.prompt: 我有个叫「{knowledgeBase}」的知识库，帮我找一下它的 ID。
cases.setup: Use a knowledge base owned by the user and deselected for the assistant.
cases.verify: Return the canonical ID with a lookup limited to the named knowledge base.

cases.prompt: 在 #{channel} 里给消息 {messageId} 点个 👍。
cases.setup: The parent message is written by another channel member and is hidden from the private assistant. Disable full-text search.
cases.verify: The owner grants only the exact message for the reaction. Read back one reaction after adding it and zero after removal.

cases.prompt: 找到 #{channel} 里提到“周四的回归窗口”的那条消息，只在那条消息的讨论串里回复“窗口确认”。
cases.setup: Run once with an assistant-visible parent and again with a parent visible only to the Human. Pre-create the reply thread.
cases.verify: Check the reply in the actual thread and zero copies in the parent timeline. Record a visibility or unsupported-action block separately. An answer alone is insufficient.

suites.method: Give the prompt verbatim with no workflow hints. Record first-attempt results before retries. If a normal confirmation appears, record what it covers; interventions or hints are reported separately.
